patterns.name: Ignoring User Messages
examples: The messages below were generated by the user while running local commands.
patterns.suggestion: Always acknowledge and respond to user messages, even if they are generated by local commands.

beforeAfter.after: Always acknowledge and respond to user messages, even if they are generated by local commands.

patterns.name: Vague Package Update Request
examples: How can I update all my packages to the latest published versions and update package.jsona accordingly?
patterns.suggestion: Please provide a step-by-step guide on how to update all packages to their latest versions, including updating package.json.
